title: Efficient Personalization of Generative User Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2604.09876v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative user interfaces (GenUIs) create new opportunities to adapt interfaces to individual users on demand. Yet personalization is difficult because it is not possible to provide settings for screens that have not yet been generated, making it necessary to learn preferences from users' feedback on generated interfaces. Such feedback is sparse, subjective, and often difficult to articulate. We study this problem through a new dataset in which 20 participants each judge the same 600 pairs of GenUIs. Their judgments differ substantially (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.25), and written rationales show that even when participants consider similar UI properties, such as color tone or hierarchy, they often make different choices and prioritize them differently. We develop a sample-efficient personalization method that uses a few pairwise judgments to weight prior users' preferences rather than relying on a fixed rubric of UI attributes.

translated_title: 生成式用户界面的高效个性化
translated_abstract: 生成式用户界面为按需适配个体用户的界面创造了新的机会。然而，个性化十分困难，因为无法为尚未生成的屏幕提供设置选项，因此必须从用户对生成界面的反馈中学习其偏好。这类反馈稀疏、主观，且往往难以清晰表达。我们通过一个新数据集来研究这一问题，该数据集中20名参与者各自评判相同的600对生成式用户界面。他们的判断存在显著差异（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.25），书面理由表明，即使参与者关注相似的UI属性（如色调或层级结构），他们也常常做出不同的选择，并以不同的方式确定这些属性的优先级。我们开发了一种样本高效的个性化方法，该方法仅需少量成对判断即可对先前用户的偏好进行加权，而无需依赖固定的UI属性评分规则。
tldr: 本文通过20名参与者评判600对生成式用户界面的新数据集揭示了个体偏好的显著差异，并提出一种仅需少量成对反馈、通过加权先前用户偏好（而非固定UI属性规则）实现高效个性化的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals substantial individual preference differences through a new dataset of 20 participants judging 600 pairs of generative user interfaces, and proposes a sample-efficient personalization method that weights prior users' preferences using only a few pairwise judgments instead of a fixed UI attribute rubric.
